lines: No airt un-tenanted by thee; all hours thy tissue —
gotten already, yet when got, Lord? Utter.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yā yā dik tatra na kvāsi sarvaḥ kālo bhavanmayaḥ iti labdho 'pi karhi tvaṃ lapsyase nātha kathyatām

reads_against.argmap: Whatever quarter, there never absent; all time made of you. → Already won everywhere, yet when won? Tell, O lord.
c1_essence: Already won, yet when won: tell; clear-heart tenant, ash-white swan bowed.

l2.plain_english: No direction lacks you; all hours are your stuff — won already, yet when, lord, shall I win you? Speak.
